interpretation: The supplied single image defines the visible composition. Hidden circulation and hypogeum are authored functional continuations, not observed historical reconstructions.
Two deep exterior arcades, 64 bays each, a 24-row stepped cavea, 16 radial aisles, and a north axial imperial loggia preserve the reference silhouette.
The river, bridge, temple and aqueduct remain background anchors. Nearby streets, market and arena are explorable; distant hills are scenery.
All humans including statuary are derived from the bundled validated CharacterBase. Crowd variants reuse exact geometry; no billboard crowds.
